run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to compute adsorption energy for an adsorbate plus surface atoms object
compute_adsorption_energy: compute adsorption energy using DFT slab energies and gas reference energy from an adslab system
relax_adslab_system: relax an adsorbate-slab system with an ASE calculator and optimizer to find minimum energy configuration
compute_hybrid_adsorption: compute hybrid adsorption energy combining ML-relaxed adslab energies with DFT slab reference energies
relax_surface_and_compute_full_adsorptio: relax the bare surface and compute full predicted adsorption energy using ML relaxed slabs
